products.name: Classic Memoroids

faqs.q: How do I send you my photos?
faqs.a: Upload them on the product page while ordering - straight from your phone or laptop. Prefer chatting? Place your order and send your photos to us on WhatsApp or email with your order number.

faqs.q: How long will my order take to arrive?
faqs.a: We print and dispatch within 48 hours. Delivery usually takes 5-7 working days across India depending on your pincode, and you'll get a tracking link by SMS and email.

faqs.q: Will I see a preview before you print?
faqs.a: Yes, for designed products like magazines, newspapers and calendars we share a digital preview for your approval first. Prints, magnets and frames go straight to print so they reach you faster.

faqs.q: What if my photos aren't high quality?
faqs.a: Our team checks every photo before printing. If something looks blurry or too dark to print well, we'll get in touch and help you pick a better one.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and popular wallets - all processed through a secure, encrypted payment gateway.

faqs.q: Do you take bulk or corporate orders?
faqs.a: Yes! We create bulk orders from 25 units for weddings, events and teams, with custom branding and packaging. Share your requirement on our Bulk orders page for a quote within one working day.
It's rare, but if anything arrives damaged or misprinted, send us a photo within 48 hours of delivery and we'll reprint it free of charge.
